cards.ex: He just flew off the handle when I told him I'd scratched his car.
cards.exUz: Men unga mashinasini chizib qo'yganimni aytganimda, u birdaniga jahli chiqib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga qattiq g'azablanmoq, o'zini tutib tura olmaslik.

cards.ex: I was scared stiff when I heard that noise in the middle of the night.
cards.exUz: Tunda shovqin eshitganimda, qattiq qo'rqib ketdim.
cards.uzDef: Shunchalik qo'rqib ketishki, qimirlay olmay qolish.

cards.ex: She was shaking like a leaf before her exam.
cards.exUz: U imtihon oldidan bargdek titrayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq qo'rquv, asabiylik yoki sovuqdan titramoq.

cards.ex: My dad blew a fuse when he saw the mess I'd made.
cards.exUz: Otam men qilgan tartibsizlikni ko'rgach, jahli chiqib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda g'azablanmoq, sabr kosasi to'lmoq.

cards.ex: The loud bang made me jump out of my skin.
cards.exUz: Qattiq portlash meni dahshatdan sakratib yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga qo'rqib ketib, sakrab tushmoq.

cards.ex: I've been on edge all day waiting for this phone call.
cards.exUz: Men butun kun davomida shu telefon qo'ng'irog'ini kutib xavotirda bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Xavotirda, asabiy, tinch emas holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: I only asked a question, there's no need to bite my head off!
cards.exUz: Men faqat savol berdim, menga baqirishning hojati yo'q!
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga qattiq jahldorlik bilan gapirmoq.

cards.ex: Don't freak out, but I lost the keys.
cards.exUz: Sarosimaga tushma, lekin men kalitlarni yo'qotib qo'ydim.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq qo'rqib ketmoq, sarosimaga tushmoq.

cards.ex: I'm petrified of spiders.
cards.exUz: Men o'rgimchaklardan juda qo'rqaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir juda qattiq qo'rqish.

cards.ex: I needed to get that off my chest.
cards.exUz: Menga bu haqda aytish kerak edi, yengil tortish uchun.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga o'zining muammolari haqida aytib, yengil tortmoq.

cards.ex: His arrogance just makes my blood boil.
cards.exUz: Uning manmanligi meni juda g'azablantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir juda ham g'azablantirishi.

cards.ex: I was taken aback by his rude behaviour.
cards.exUz: Men uning qo'pol xatti-harakatidan hayratda qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir kutilmaganda hayratda qolmoq.

cards.ex: He vented his frustration by shouting at the TV.
cards.exUz: U o'zining g'azabini televizorga baqirib sochdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining g'azabini, noroziligini tashqi tomonga chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: After the argument, she kept him at arm's length.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan keyin, u undan uzoqlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir yoki nimadandir o'zini uzoq tutmoq.

cards.ex: My mom will hit the roof if I fail the test.
cards.exUz: Agar imtihondan o'ta olmasam, onam juda g'azablanadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq g'azablanmoq, g'azabdan portlamoq.

cards.ex: I woke up in a cold sweat after the nightmare.
cards.exUz: Men dahshatli tushdan keyin sovuq terga botib uyg'ondim.
cards.uzDef: Qo'rquv, xavotir yoki kasallik tufayli sovuq terga botmoq.

cards.ex: I decided to face my fears and go skydiving.
cards.exUz: Men qo'rquvlarimga qarshi kurashishga va parashyutda sakrashga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: O'zining qo'rquviga qarshi kurashmoq, qo'rquvni yengmoq.

cards.ex: Don't get so worked up about it, it's not worth it.
cards.exUz: Bu haqda bunchalik hayajonlanma, bunga arzimaydi.
cards.uzDef: Juda hayajonda, asabiy yoki tashvishda bo'lish.

cards.ex: When he saw the police, he froze like a deer caught in headlights.
cards.exUz: U politsiyani ko'rgach, faralar chirog'idagi bug'udek qotib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga qo'rqib ketib harakat qila olmay qolmoq.

cards.ex: He lost his temper and started shouting.
cards.exUz: U jahli chiqib ketdi va baqira boshladi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini tuta olmay qolmoq, g'azablanmoq.

cards.ex: She was a nervous wreck before the presentation.
cards.exUz: U taqdimot oldidan juda asabiy holatda edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda asabiy, xavotirda va stressda bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: Just chill out, everything will be okay.
cards.exUz: Shunchaki tinchlan, hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Tinchlanmoq, xotirjam bo'lmoq, asabiylashmaslik.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip and stop crying.
cards.exUz: Sen o'zingni qo'lga olishing va yig'lashni to'xtatishing kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zini qo'lga olmoq, his-tuyg'ularni nazorat qilmoq.

cards.ex: That horror movie scared the pants off me.
cards.exUz: Bu qo'rqinchli kino meni juda qo'rqitib yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir juda qattiq qo'rqitib yubormoq.

cards.ex: He was brimming with anger after the argument.
cards.exUz: U janjaldan keyin g'azabga to'lgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq g'azablanmoq, g'azabdan portlashga tayyor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I had a knot in my stomach before the interview.
cards.exUz: Suhbat oldidan qornimda xavotir bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Xavotir tufayli qorinda noqulaylik hissi paydo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: It's not healthy to bottle up your emotions.
cards.exUz: O'z his-tuyg'ularingni yashirish sog'lom emas.
cards.uzDef: O'zining his-tuyg'ularini yashirmoq, tashqi tomonga chiqarmaslik.

cards.ex: Her face turned white when she heard the news.
cards.exUz: U yangilikni eshitgach, yuzi oqarib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'rquv, kasallik yoki shokka tushish natijasida yuz rangi oqarishi.

cards.ex: Take deep breaths, it will help you calm down.
cards.exUz: Chuqur nafas ol, bu senga tinchlanishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Xotirjam bo'lish uchun chuqur nafas olmoq.

cards.ex: I'm on pins and needles waiting for the exam results.
cards.exUz: Men imtihon natijalarini kutib juda xavotirdaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimanidir kutishdan juda xavotirda bo'lish.
